name: ukrainian-interface-restates-quick-player
description: A Ukrainian Quick player resolves translated settings-menu labels and its real settings-button tooltip before the run begins.

steps.note: Open the real Quick settings menu from its in-scene button.

assertions.note: PlayerSettings is an actual scene panel, and its visibility proves the settings request reached the UI.
The visible Quick settings panel renders this real speed delegate; its displayed label must be translated instead of the English source.
The delegate identity remains the stable row id used by the translated Quick menu model.
The actual Quick settings button tooltip is translated independently from the cached menu row.
